learnerGoal.zh: 用同口径比较完整业务处理时间。
learnerGoal.en: Compare end-to-end handling time on a consistent basis.

thinking.zh: 不能遗漏复核时间，也不能拿局部环节当全部节省。
thinking.en: Do not omit review time or treat one step as total savings.

understandingEvidence.zh: 提交含生成与复核时间后的净节省40分钟。
understandingEvidence.en: Submit a review-inclusive net saving of 40 minutes.

misconception.zh: 只看生成时间就宣称全部流程提效。
misconception.en: Declaring end-to-end efficiency from generation time alone.

title.zh: 产能、现金与业务指标

learnerGoals.zh: 用实际支出变化核验已兑现现金节省，不把重复申报变成两份收益。
learnerGoals.en: Verify realized cash savings against actual expenditure without treating duplicate claims as separate benefits.

learnerGoals.zh: 预算覆盖资料、运营、人工与退出等阶段。
learnerGoals.en: Include source, operating, human and exit stages in budgets.

learnerGoals.zh: 计算同期间完整成本与简单ROI。
learnerGoals.en: Calculate full same-period costs and simple ROI.

learnerGoals.zh: 知道早期信号不保证最终成功。
learnerGoals.en: Know that early signals do not guarantee final success.

reason.zh: 旧应用与正式题都靠工资未变但工时释放判断，证据分支重复；改为核算实际账单支出变化并识别同一减支被重复申报。
reason.en: The old application repeated the formal unchanged-payroll/freed-time branch; now calculate a real invoice reduction and detect duplicate claims for the same saving.

learnerGoal.zh: 用实际支出变化核验已兑现现金节省，不把重复申报变成两份收益。
learnerGoal.en: Verify realized cash savings against actual expenditure without treating duplicate claims as separate benefits.

thinking.zh: 账单减少了多少，以及两份报告是否指向同一笔减少。
thinking.en: Determine how much spending fell and whether two reports refer to the same reduction.

understandingEvidence.zh: 提交本项账单实际减少3500元、重复申报多记3500元；本题不计算项目净收益或ROI。
understandingEvidence.en: Submit an actual invoice reduction of 3,500 and duplicate overstatement of 3,500; this task does not calculate project net benefit or ROI.

misconception.zh: 把同一笔支出减少被两个部门报告当成两份独立现金节省。
misconception.en: Treat two reports of the same expenditure reduction as separate cash savings.

reason.zh: 完整生命周期各项费用仍需自行汇总；目标是查漏，不是背成本名词。
reason.en: Lifecycle costs must be totaled; the objective is detecting omissions rather than memorizing cost names.

learnerGoal.zh: 预算覆盖资料、运营、人工与退出等阶段。
learnerGoal.en: Include source, operating, human and exit stages in budgets.

thinking.zh: 哪些必要支出不能因只看模型调用而忽略。
thinking.en: Identify necessary expenditure beyond model calls.

understandingEvidence.zh: 提交年度完整成本100万元；本控件只采集合计，不采集自行解释漏项。
understandingEvidence.en: Submit annual full cost of 100 in the stated ten-thousand currency units; this control captures a total, not a learner-authored explanation of omissions.

misconception.zh: 调用费就是全部成本。
misconception.en: Call charges are the entire cost.

reason.zh: 保留多项成本汇总与ROI实算，删除字段单位提示“填80代表80%”；该数字恰为本题答案，会直接泄露结果。
reason.en: Keep full-cost summation and ROI calculation, but remove the field hint “80 means 80%”: 80 is this task’s answer and directly leaks the result.

learnerGoal.zh: 计算同期间完整成本与简单ROI。
learnerGoal.en: Calculate full same-period costs and simple ROI.

thinking.zh: 先去掉成本得到净收益，再选择完整成本为分母。
thinking.en: Subtract full costs to obtain net benefits and use full cost as denominator.

understandingEvidence.zh: 提交同年完整成本核算下的ROI百分数80；该数值不能单独证明会自由解释核算边界。
understandingEvidence.en: Submit ROI percentage 80 using the full same-year costs; the number alone does not demonstrate a learner-authored explanation of accounting boundaries.

misconception.zh: 把总收益直接除成本，或漏培训维护复核。
misconception.en: Divide gross benefits by costs or omit training, maintenance and review.

reason.zh: 在两个实际指标之间区分早期信号与结果，目标是证据性质，非机械字段归位。
reason.en: Distinguishes early signals from realized outcomes in actual metrics rather than field placement.

learnerGoal.zh: 知道早期信号不保证最终成功。
learnerGoal.en: Know that early signals do not guarantee final success.

thinking.zh: 指标记录的是活动已做，还是业务结果已发生。
thinking.en: Identify whether the measure records activity or a realized business result.

understandingEvidence.zh: 将培训完成率与已实现净收益分别归入先导信号和结果指标。
understandingEvidence.en: Classify training completion and realized net benefits as a leading signal and outcome measure respectively.

misconception.zh: 培训完成即已经证明业务成功。
misconception.en: Training completion proves business success.

title.zh: 完整成本与归因证据

learnerGoals.zh: 在质量约束内核算用量和完整运营预算。
learnerGoals.en: Account for usage and operating budgets under a quality constraint.

learnerGoals.zh: 用业务变化而非工具热度评价结果。
learnerGoals.en: Evaluate business changes rather than tool popularity.

learnerGoals.zh: 报告已实现现金和独立体验证据，不编造换算。
learnerGoals.en: Report realized cash and independent experience evidence without fabricated conversion.

learnerGoals.zh: 区分AI效果与同期其他变化。
learnerGoals.en: Distinguish AI effects from simultaneous changes.

reason.zh: 需将调用和复核数量按单价计算并换算同单位，再对预算，不是简单抄写。
reason.en: Requires quantity-times-price computation and consistent units before budget comparison.

learnerGoal.zh: 在质量约束内核算用量和完整运营预算。
learnerGoal.en: Account for usage and operating budgets under a quality constraint.

thinking.zh: 区分固定成本、调用成本、人工复核成本及预算余量。
thinking.en: Distinguish fixed, call and review costs and budget headroom.

understandingEvidence.zh: 提交当月总成本70万元与预算余量10万元。
understandingEvidence.en: Submit monthly total cost of 70 and budget headroom of 10 in the stated ten-thousand currency units.

misconception.zh: 忽略复核或把元与万元直接相加。
misconception.en: Omit review or add incompatible currency units.

reason.zh: 账号活动和业务变化的分类有清楚的语义判断，保留；反馈已指出质量/复核代价。
reason.en: Classification of account activity and business change requires a clear semantic judgment; existing feedback covers quality and review cost.

learnerGoal.zh: 用业务变化而非工具热度评价结果。
learnerGoal.en: Evaluate business changes rather than tool popularity.

thinking.zh: 做了多少与改善了什么不是同一件事。
thinking.en: The amount of activity differs from what improved.

understandingEvidence.zh: 将给定条目分入活动或业务结果类别；不据分类表现声称学习者已设计新指标。
understandingEvidence.en: Classify supplied items as activities or business outcomes; classification does not demonstrate designing a new metric.

misconception.zh: 账号增长代表业务结果必然改善。
misconception.en: More accounts necessarily mean better business outcomes.

reason.zh: 需对无货币依据的信任改善选择诚实报告，答案不是给定字符串。
reason.en: Requires choosing an honest report for unmonetized trust improvement, not transcribing a string.

learnerGoal.zh: 报告已实现现金和独立体验证据，不编造换算。
learnerGoal.en: Report realized cash and independent experience evidence without fabricated conversion.

thinking.zh: 信任问卷有价值，但是否足以证明现金增加。
thinking.en: Recognize trust evidence as valuable without treating it as cash proof.

understandingEvidence.zh: 选中分别报告支出减少与信任变化、且不编造金额换算的报告选项。
understandingEvidence.en: Select the report separating spending reduction from trust changes without inventing a cash conversion.

misconception.zh: 把无形收益任意折算成现金以扩大ROI。
misconception.en: Convert intangible benefits arbitrarily to inflate ROI.

reason.zh: 要在任务难度变化的混杂条件下选择对照设计，是真正证据判断。
reason.en: Selects a comparison design under changing task difficulty, a genuine evidence judgment.

learnerGoal.zh: 区分AI效果与同期其他变化。
learnerGoal.en: Distinguish AI effects from simultaneous changes.

thinking.zh: 两组任务是否可比较、口径是否含复核、趋势是否受控。
thinking.en: Check comparability, review-inclusive definitions and time trends.

understandingEvidence.zh: 选中按任务难度和业务量匹配、统一含复核口径并设置对照的设计。
understandingEvidence.en: Select the design matching task difficulty and volume, using review-inclusive definitions and a comparison group.

misconception.zh: 上线后的所有改善都由AI造成。
misconception.en: Every post-launch improvement is caused by AI.

title.zh: ROI核算与业务转型

learnerGoals.zh: 算ROI前核对期间、单位、收益实现和成本范围。
learnerGoals.en: Check period, units, benefit realization and cost scope before ROI.

learnerGoals.zh: 检验先导信号是否真的伴随业务结果改善。
learnerGoals.en: Test whether leading signals are accompanied by improved business outcomes.

learnerGoals.zh: 把竞争变化连接到自身客户障碍。
learnerGoals.en: Connect competitive changes to local customer barriers.

learnerGoals.zh: 理解持续服务改变客户价值和运营要求。
learnerGoals.en: Understand how ongoing service changes value and operations.

reason.zh: 与概览ROI题重复一次同公式计算，未验证核算边界；改为判定哪些方案可按共同期间计算。
reason.en: Repeated the overview formula without testing accounting boundaries; now judge whether accounting periods and scopes permit calculation.

learnerGoal.zh: 算ROI前核对期间、单位、收益实现和成本范围。
learnerGoal.en: Check period, units, benefit realization and cost scope before ROI.

thinking.zh: 有数字不表示可相除；材料是否支持同口径比较。
thinking.en: Numbers alone do not justify division; evidence must support comparable scope.

understandingEvidence.zh: 将同年完整资料申请放入可计算类，将期间未协调和缺复核成本的申请放入补资料类。
understandingEvidence.en: Classify the complete same-year request as calculable, and requests with unreconciled periods or missing review costs as needing evidence.

misconception.zh: 季度收益可以直接除全年成本，遗漏成本也照算。
misconception.en: Quarterly benefits can be divided by annual costs, or omitted costs ignored.

reason.zh: 旧题直接给训练→核验→质量顺序，不能证明理解先导与结果的联系；改为计算并评价新数据。
reason.en: The old prompt supplied training→verification→quality order; replace it with calculation and interpretation of new evidence.

learnerGoal.zh: 检验先导信号是否真的伴随业务结果改善。
learnerGoal.en: Test whether leading signals are accompanied by improved business outcomes.

thinking.zh: 培训完成率提高时，后续质量是否有可比改善证据。
thinking.en: When training completion rises, determine whether comparable quality improved.

understandingEvidence.zh: 提交前后两期差错率均为10%，并选中早期信号提高而服务质量尚未显示改善的两项结论。
understandingEvidence.en: Submit 10% for both error rates and select the statements that the leading signal improved while this service-quality metric did not.

misconception.zh: 培训完成率高就等于服务质量已提高。
misconception.en: High training completion proves improved service quality.

reason.zh: 面对竞争者工具与本企业退款问题选择调查重点，已在新场景中应用概念。
reason.en: Chooses investigation priorities when a competitor tool differs from the local refund problem.

learnerGoal.zh: 把竞争变化连接到自身客户障碍。
learnerGoal.en: Connect competitive changes to local customer barriers.

thinking.zh: 同行行动是否真的解决本企业的问题。
thinking.en: Determine whether a competitor action addresses the local problem.

understandingEvidence.zh: 选中调查退款障碍、客户期待与自身可改善环节的选项。
understandingEvidence.en: Select the option investigating refund barriers, customer expectations and locally improvable steps.

misconception.zh: 竞争者用了就必须同样采购。
misconception.en: Competitor adoption requires identical purchasing.

reason.zh: 从一次性报告到持续服务要求重新判断价值、维护与交付，非只复述业务模式定义。
reason.en: Moving from reports to ongoing service requires value, maintenance and delivery judgments rather than definition recall.

learnerGoal.zh: 理解持续服务改变客户价值和运营要求。
learnerGoal.en: Understand how ongoing service changes value and operations.

thinking.zh: 哪些承诺从一次性输出变为持续责任。
thinking.en: Identify promises that become continuing obligations.

understandingEvidence.zh: 选中持续客户价值/交付流程和数据维护/运营责任两项，不选只修改标签。
understandingEvidence.en: Select ongoing value/delivery and data-maintenance/operations responsibilities, not relabeling alone.

misconception.zh: 给产品加AI标签就完成转型。
misconception.en: An AI label completes transformation.

title.zh: 优势证据与价值交付

learnerGoals.zh: 知道持续优势来自数据、流程、人员和反馈组合。
learnerGoals.en: Know that durable advantage depends on combined data, workflows, people and feedback.

learnerGoals.zh: 使投入与准备度、风险和验证证据相匹配。
learnerGoals.en: Match investment to readiness, risk and validation evidence.

learnerGoals.zh: 选择针对本企业客户和价值链的调查。
learnerGoals.en: Choose investigation of local customers and value-chain effects.

learnerGoals.zh: 说明提供什么价值、如何交付、怎样获得收益。
learnerGoals.en: Explain value offered, delivery and revenue logic.

reason.zh: 原题泛问哪些好行动，容易凭褒贬措辞猜；改为对比同一模型下两组织的实际能力证据。
reason.en: The old task invited guessing positive-sounding actions; compare operational evidence in organizations using the same model.

learnerGoal.zh: 知道持续优势来自数据、流程、人员和反馈组合。
learnerGoal.en: Know that durable advantage depends on combined data, workflows, people and feedback.

thinking.zh: 相同模型是否说明相同可持续能力。
thinking.en: Assess whether equal models imply equal sustained capabilities.

understandingEvidence.zh: 选中甲有互补条件但仍需跟踪、乙账号数不足以证明优势两项有依据判断。
understandingEvidence.en: Select the supported statements that A has complementary conditions requiring monitoring and B account counts do not establish advantage.

misconception.zh: 购买相同基础模型就拥有相同长期优势。
misconception.en: The same foundation model yields the same durable advantage.

reason.zh: 原题先报治理→试点→扩展再要求照排；改为证据不足时如何分阶段承诺。
reason.en: The old prompt supplied governance→pilot→scale; use evidence-based staged commitments instead.

learnerGoal.zh: 使投入与准备度、风险和验证证据相匹配。
learnerGoal.en: Match investment to readiness, risk and validation evidence.

thinking.zh: 外部竞争压力能否替代内部缺失的准备条件。
thinking.en: Judge whether competitive pressure can replace missing internal readiness.

understandingEvidence.zh: 提交含资料质量与小范围结果验证、未超预算且不含未获准全量扩展的组合。
understandingEvidence.en: Submit a within-budget package with source-quality and limited-outcome validation, excluding unauthorized full rollout.

misconception.zh: 竞争紧迫就应跳过准备直接扩大投入。
misconception.en: Competitive urgency warrants skipping readiness and scaling immediately.

reason.zh: 题设本企业客户障碍未知，需判断竞争投资只是线索而非收益证据；可保留。
reason.en: Local barriers are unknown, so competitor spending must be treated as a clue rather than local return evidence.

learnerGoal.zh: 选择针对本企业客户和价值链的调查。
learnerGoal.en: Choose investigation of local customers and value-chain effects.

thinking.zh: 竞争者金额与本企业可获价值之间缺什么证据。
thinking.en: Identify the missing link between competitor spending and local value.

understandingEvidence.zh: 选中调查自身客户期待、交付障碍与价值链影响的选项。
understandingEvidence.en: Select investigation of local customer expectations, delivery barriers and value-chain effects.

misconception.zh: 同行投资大就是本企业收益证明。
misconception.en: Large competitor spending proves local returns.

reason.zh: 将具体服务条目归入客户所得、持续交付、收入逻辑，考的是业务角色而非编码。
reason.en: Classifies actual service components as customer benefit, delivery or revenue, testing business roles rather than codes.

learnerGoal.zh: 说明提供什么价值、如何交付、怎样获得收益。
learnerGoal.en: Explain value offered, delivery and revenue logic.

thinking.zh: 提醒、维护和收费分别解决哪个业务模式问题。
thinking.en: Determine which business-model question alerts, maintenance and charging answer.

understandingEvidence.zh: 将异常提醒、持续维护响应和服务期收费分别归入客户价值、交付、收益逻辑。
understandingEvidence.en: Classify alerts, continuous maintenance/response and period-based charges as value, delivery and revenue logic.

misconception.zh: 把AI标签当完整业务模式。
misconception.en: Treat an AI label as a complete business model.

title.zh: 学习闭环与分阶段承诺

learnerGoals.zh: 用授权资料、领域经验和结果反馈形成可持续改进。
learnerGoals.en: Combine authorized sources, domain expertise and outcome feedback for ongoing improvement.

learnerGoals.zh: 按预先定义的多维门槛决定扩展或暂停。
learnerGoals.en: Use predeclared multidimensional gates to decide expansion or pause.

reason.zh: 原题将完整反馈顺序直接写出；换新场景依赖线索，不再抄给定顺序。
reason.en: The old prompt disclosed the entire feedback sequence; use dependencies in a new scenario instead.

learnerGoal.zh: 用授权资料、领域经验和结果反馈形成可持续改进。
learnerGoal.en: Combine authorized sources, domain expertise and outcome feedback for ongoing improvement.

thinking.zh: 未核验投诉能否直接驱动流程改动，改动后何种证据才能闭环。
thinking.en: Decide whether unverified complaints can drive changes and what closes the loop after a change.

understandingEvidence.zh: 提交核验投诉→试行流程改动→比较后续失约结果的工作顺序；不把它当成实际改进已成功。
understandingEvidence.en: Submit complaint verification→workflow trial→outcome comparison; this does not demonstrate that a real improvement has succeeded.

misconception.zh: 只增加模型采购或绕过资料授权就完成持续学习。
misconception.en: Buying more models or bypassing source authorization creates continuous learning.

reason.zh: 保留成本超额计算，删除scale/pause内部字符串输入；追加真实扩展决策及依据。
reason.en: Retain cost-overrun calculation, remove scale/pause transcription, and require an actual expansion decision.

learnerGoal.zh: 按预先定义的多维门槛决定扩展或暂停。
learnerGoal.en: Use predeclared multidimensional gates to decide expansion or pause.

thinking.zh: 其他条件通过是否能抵消超预算，能否事后改门槛。
thinking.en: Judge whether other passing gates offset overbudget costs or justify changing gates afterward.

understandingEvidence.zh: 提交月成本12万元、超额2万元，并选中暂停扩大且验证成本改进的承诺。
understandingEvidence.en: Submit monthly cost 12 and excess 2 in the stated units, and select pausing expansion pending verified cost improvement.

misconception.zh: 把通过的质量条件用于覆盖未通过的成本条件。
misconception.en: Use a passing quality gate to offset a failed cost gate.

title.zh: 责任原则、群体影响与约束

learnerGoals.zh: 把责任原则转为可观察的控制
learnerGoals.en: Turn responsibility principles into observable controls

learnerGoals.zh: 判断总体指标不能证明分组公平
learnerGoals.en: Recognize that aggregates cannot establish group fairness

learnerGoals.zh: 按风险目的区分互补控制
learnerGoals.en: Distinguish complementary controls by risk purpose

learnerGoals.zh: 在收益目标下保留责任硬约束
learnerGoals.en: Preserve responsibility constraints while pursuing benefits

reason.zh: 保留实质判断：学习者必须比较海报、分组评估与异常测试哪项留下控制证据；不是重填题干给定代码。
reason.en: Retain substantive judgment: the learner must compare posters, subgroup evaluation and abnormal tests as control evidence rather than re-enter a supplied code.

learnerGoal.zh: 把责任原则转为可观察的控制
learnerGoal.en: Turn responsibility principles into observable controls

thinking.zh: 比较海报、分组评估与异常测试哪项留下控制证据
thinking.en: Compare posters, subgroup evaluation and abnormal tests as control evidence

understandingEvidence.zh: 实际记录的操作为：选中「记录相关群体的差错并评审；在异常输入下测试并记录结果」且不选其余候选。这些结果不单独证明学习者已经作出自由解释。
understandingEvidence.en: The captured actions are: Select “Record and review errors for relevant groups；Test abnormal inputs and record results” and no other options. These results alone do not establish that the learner has supplied a free explanation.

misconception.zh: 原则写在墙上就等于已经实施
misconception.en: A displayed principle counts as an implemented control

reason.zh: 保留实质判断：学习者必须从缺少群体明细的5%总体差错判断缺少哪些证据；不是重填题干给定代码。
reason.en: Retain substantive judgment: the learner must identify evidence missing behind a 5% aggregate error rate rather than re-enter a supplied code.

learnerGoal.zh: 判断总体指标不能证明分组公平
learnerGoal.en: Recognize that aggregates cannot establish group fairness

understandingEvidence.zh: 实际记录的操作为：提交这些分类位置：「担心真实客户资料会被送到未批准服务」→「核查控制与风险」；「获准练习也不敢试，害怕错误导致惩罚」→「限定范围安全练习」；「试用后发现工具无法处理本岗位必需格式」→「核对工具与流程适配」。这些结果不单独证明学习者已经作出自由解释。
understandingEvidence.en: The captured actions are: Submit these placements: 「Worries that real customer data will go to an unapproved service」→「Inspect controls and risk」；「Avoids even approved practice for fear of punishment」→「Bounded safe practice」；「Finds the tool cannot handle a format required by the role」→「Check tool/workflow fit」. These results alone do not establish that the learner has supplied a free explanation.

misconception.zh: 问题反馈是阻碍推广而应禁止
misconception.en: Issue reports obstruct adoption and should be banned

reason.zh: 与正式题流畅却无来源分离：本题已有核验资料，比较流畅夸大与不流畅但受支持的答复。
reason.en: Unlike the fluent/no-source formal question, this case supplies verification evidence and contrasts fluent exaggeration with an awkward but supported answer.

learnerGoal.zh: 识别流畅但无支持的重要结论
learnerGoal.en: Recognize fluent but unsupported consequential claims

thinking.zh: 在有核验记录的两份答复中保留证据支持的事实而非更流畅的夸大
thinking.en: Retain verified facts rather than a more fluent overstatement when checking two responses

understandingEvidence.zh: 实际记录的操作为：选中「保留23份已复核、1份待补的事实边界；可以改善乙的表达，但不能把未完成改写成已通过」且不选其余候选。这些结果不单独证明学习者已经作出自由解释。
understandingEvidence.en: The captured actions are: Select “Retain the boundary: 23 reviewed and one awaiting material；Improve B wording without converting unfinished work into approval” and no other options. These results alone do not establish that the learner has supplied a free explanation.

misconception.zh: 有引用或流畅就意味着可靠
misconception.en: Fluency or a citation establishes reliability

reason.zh: 删除已核验1/未知0抄码；逐条比较真实摘录、结论和版本不确定性。
reason.en: Remove verified/unknown numeric copying and compare an excerpt, claims and version uncertainty.

learnerGoal.zh: 区分原文支持、矛盾与未知
learnerGoal.en: Distinguish source support, contradiction and uncertainty

thinking.zh: 逐条比较结论与摘录并限制版本未知的使用范围
thinking.en: Compare claims with an excerpt and limit conclusions when version currency is unknown

understandingEvidence.zh: 实际记录的操作为：提交这些分类位置：「这份摘录写的是7天」→「所给摘录直接支持」；「这份摘录支持承诺30天」→「与摘录冲突」；「今天对所有客户都应承诺7天」→「尚需其他证据」。这些结果不单独证明学习者已经作出自由解释。
understandingEvidence.en: The captured actions are: Submit these placements: 「This excerpt says 7 days」→「Directly supported by this excerpt」；「This excerpt supports promising 30 days」→「Contradicts the excerpt」；「Today all customers should be promised 7 days」→「Needs additional evidence」. These results alone do not establish that the learner has supplied a free explanation.

misconception.zh: 主题相关等于所有结论都被引用支持
misconception.en: Topic relevance supports every cited claim

title.zh: 岗位判断与阶段扩展

learnerGoals.zh: 用真实岗位判断证明能力
learnerGoals.en: Demonstrate competence through real role judgment

learnerGoals.zh: 不能从重复频率推出自动决策授权
learnerGoals.en: Do not infer automatic decision authority from repetition

learnerGoals.zh: 用反馈决定迭代而非一次替换
learnerGoals.en: Use feedback to iterate rather than replace everything at once

learnerGoals.zh: 验证试点成果能否迁移
learnerGoals.en: Test whether pilot results transfer

reason.zh: 与正式题客服只会操作但不能处理政策未知分离：员工已展示判断，考查表现证据与组织正式认定的边界。
reason.en: Unlike the formal tool-fluent but unprepared employee, performance is demonstrated; distinguish that evidence from formal organizational approval.

learnerGoal.zh: 用真实岗位判断证明能力
learnerGoal.en: Demonstrate competence through real role judgment

thinking.zh: 保留已经展示的岗位表现证据并区分它与组织正式胜任认定
thinking.en: Preserve demonstrated role-task evidence while distinguishing it from formal organizational competence approval

understandingEvidence.zh: 实际记录的操作为：选中「保留已经展示的真实任务表现，交指定评估者按明确标准认定；补齐评估者、证据要求、通过标准和接手责任」且不选其余候选。这些结果不单独证明学习者已经作出自由解释。
understandingEvidence.en: The captured actions are: Select “Preserve demonstrated task performance for a designated assessor using explicit criteria；Define assessors, evidence requirements, pass criteria and handover ownership” and no other options. These results alone do not establish that the learner has supplied a free explanation.

misconception.zh: 按钮位置记忆代表岗位判断
misconception.en: Button recall establishes role judgment

reason.zh: 原任务再次重复投诉草稿核验/发送；改为重复性指标与具体后果冲突时能否授权维修调度，观察责任证据判断。
reason.en: Replace another complaint-draft check/send task with an authority decision when repetitive repair prioritization conflicts with consequences.

learnerGoal.zh: 不能从重复频率推出自动决策授权
learnerGoal.en: Do not infer automatic decision authority from repetition

thinking.zh: 从维修优先级的后果差异识别还缺的判断依据与授权
thinking.en: Identify missing contextual evidence and authority from consequences of repair prioritization

understandingEvidence.zh: 实际记录的操作为：选中「先由负责人核验不同故障后果并明确承诺权限，记录取舍；系统可继续整理工单作为辅助，但频率本身不构成自动承诺授权」且不选其余候选。这些结果不单独证明学习者已经作出自由解释。
understandingEvidence.en: The captured actions are: Select “Have an accountable person check consequences, establish commitment authority and record trade-offs；The system may assist by organizing tickets, but frequency alone does not authorize commitments” and no other options. These results alone do not establish that the learner has supplied a free explanation.

misconception.zh: 重复工作就自动获得自动化授权
misconception.en: Repetition automatically authorizes automation

reason.zh: 原阶段排列接近复述常识；用实验失败与资源已投入的冲突检验迭代决定。
reason.en: Replace near-recall stage ordering with an iteration decision despite prior investment.

learnerGoal.zh: 用反馈决定迭代而非一次替换
learnerGoal.en: Use feedback to iterate rather than replace everything at once

thinking.zh: 从实验失败证据选择回补条件而非强行推进
thinking.en: Choose to repair conditions from experimental failure evidence

understandingEvidence.zh: 实际记录的操作为：选中「返回修复资料与验证假设，再决定下一阶段」且不选其余候选。这些结果不单独证明学习者已经作出自由解释。
understandingEvidence.en: The captured actions are: Select “Return to source repair and hypothesis validation before deciding the next stage” and no other options. These results alone do not establish that the learner has supplied a free explanation.

misconception.zh: 阶段不可回头所以必须上线
misconception.en: Stages cannot be revisited so launch is mandatory

reason.zh: 保留实质判断：学习者必须识别新团队资料、流程和支持条件的未知；不是重填题干给定代码。
reason.en: Retain substantive judgment: the learner must identify unknown data, workflow and support conditions in a new team rather than re-enter a supplied code.

learnerGoal.zh: 验证试点成果能否迁移
learnerGoal.en: Test whether pilot results transfer

thinking.zh: 识别新团队资料、流程和支持条件的未知
thinking.en: Identify unknown data, workflow and support conditions in a new team

understandingEvidence.zh: 实际记录的操作为：选中「核验初始成果并检查新团队数据、流程和支持的迁移条件」且不选其余候选。这些结果不单独证明学习者已经作出自由解释。
understandingEvidence.en: The captured actions are: Select “Verify the initial result and check new-team data, workflow and support transfer conditions” and no other options. These results alone do not establish that the learner has supplied a free explanation.

misconception.zh: 复制配置就证明适用所有部门
misconception.en: Copying configuration proves universal suitability

title.zh: 共享支持、反馈与生产接手
title.en: Shared support, feedback and production handover

learnerGoals.zh: 共享能力不替代业务用例责任
learnerGoals.en: Do not let shared capability replace business ownership

learnerGoals.zh: 同时跟踪采用和业务结果
learnerGoals.en: Track adoption together with business outcomes

learnerGoals.zh: 从监测结果选择有责任的处置
learnerGoals.en: Choose accountable responses from monitoring results

learnerGoals.zh: 以生产证据而非页面演示验收
learnerGoals.en: Accept production using evidence rather than a demo page

reason.zh: 保留实质判断：学习者必须区分复用评估方法与确认用例价值；不是重填题干给定代码。
reason.en: Retain substantive judgment: the learner must distinguish reusable evaluation from owning use-case value rather than re-enter a supplied code.

learnerGoal.zh: 共享能力不替代业务用例责任
learnerGoal.en: Do not let shared capability replace business ownership

thinking.zh: 区分复用评估方法与确认用例价值
thinking.en: Distinguish reusable evaluation from owning use-case value

understandingEvidence.zh: 实际记录的操作为：提交这些分类位置：「提供复用的评估方法」→「COE共享支持」；「确认本业务用例的价值与结果」→「业务团队责任」。这些结果不单独证明学习者已经作出自由解释。
understandingEvidence.en: The captured actions are: Submit these placements: 「Provide reusable evaluation methods」→「CoE shared support」；「Own the business use-case value and outcomes」→「Business team accountability」. These results alone do not establish that the learner has supplied a free explanation.

misconception.zh: 有COE就能移交全部业务责任
misconception.en: A CoE takes over all business accountability

reason.zh: 与正式题账号增长但结果未知分离：采用人数持平而已验证结果改善，考查不能只按采用指标否定价值。
reason.en: Unlike the formal account-growth/no-outcome case, adoption is flat while measured outcomes improve; avoid rejecting value from adoption alone.

learnerGoal.zh: 同时跟踪采用和业务结果
learnerGoal.en: Track adoption together with business outcomes

thinking.zh: 在采用人数不增而质量与成本证据改善时避免按单一指标否定价值
thinking.en: Avoid rejecting value from one adoption metric when quality and cost evidence improves

understandingEvidence.zh: 实际记录的操作为：选中「记录本期已验证的质量和成本改善，不被账号单一指标抹掉；继续检查采用障碍与长期结果，再据反馈调整计划」且不选其余候选。这些结果不单独证明学习者已经作出自由解释。
understandingEvidence.en: The captured actions are: Select “Retain verified quality and cost improvements rather than erase them with one account metric；Continue examining adoption barriers and longer-term outcomes to adapt the plan” and no other options. These results alone do not establish that the learner has supplied a free explanation.

misconception.zh: 账号开通数证明长期价值
misconception.en: Account counts establish long-term value

reason.zh: 移除状态/日志英文代码输入；保留真实失败率计算，并要求用业务动作选择处置依据。
reason.en: Remove English status/log code entry; retain failure-rate calculation and choose a justified operational response.

learnerGoal.zh: 从监测结果选择有责任的处置
learnerGoal.en: Choose accountable responses from monitoring results

thinking.zh: 计算失败率并将实际超限连接到人工接手和受控证据
thinking.en: Calculate failure rate and connect the breach to human takeover and controlled evidence

understandingEvidence.zh: 实际记录的操作为：提交判定字段：失败率（%） = 9；然后选中「交值班人接手并调查异常；保全必要受控事件标识与版本，限制敏感信息」且不选其余候选。这些结果不单独证明学习者已经作出自由解释。
understandingEvidence.en: The captured actions are: Submit the graded fields: Failure rate (%) = 9; then Select “Transfer to on-call staff and investigate；Preserve necessary controlled identifiers and versions while limiting sensitive data” and no other options. These results alone do not establish that the learner has supplied a free explanation.

misconception.zh: 会抄状态代码就证明理解事件处理
misconception.en: Copying status codes demonstrates incident-response understanding

reason.zh: 原活动按卡片“已有/没有”文字抄分类，改为评价证据是否实际证明生产条件。
reason.en: Replace copying available/missing words with assessing whether evidence actually establishes production readiness.

learnerGoal.zh: 以生产证据而非页面演示验收
learnerGoal.en: Accept production using evidence rather than a demo page

thinking.zh: 判断值守和回退证据是否足以支持转生产
thinking.en: Judge whether operations and fallback evidence support production

understandingEvidence.zh: 实际记录的操作为：提交这些分类位置：「值班表上的人员已确认接手，并在告警演练中成功接收与处理」→「已有可核验证据」；「文件名叫“回退已准备”，但恢复路径从未执行过」→「尚缺关键验证」；「演示页面能打开，因此报告宣称已证明全天运维能力」→「尚缺关键验证」。这些结果不单独证明学习者已经作出自由解释。
understandingEvidence.en: The captured actions are: Submit these placements: 「Named on-call staff accepted ownership and successfully received and handled an alert drill」→「Verifiable evidence is present」；「A document is called Fallback Ready, but its recovery route has never been exercised」→「A key validation gap remains」；「A demo page opens, so the report claims continuous operating capability」→「A key validation gap remains」. These results alone do not establish that the learner has supplied a free explanation.

misconception.zh: 文档中写有回退就等于可用
misconception.en: A written fallback is a usable fallback

title.zh: 企业扩展、迁移与业务责任
title.en: Enterprise rollout, transfer and business ownership

learnerGoals.zh: 按新团队条件控制推广节奏
learnerGoals.en: Control rollout pace using new-team conditions

learnerGoals.zh: 用阶段证据决定是否前进或返回
learnerGoals.en: Use stage evidence to progress or return

learnerGoals.zh: 比较试点与新团队的支持条件
learnerGoals.en: Compare pilot and new-team support conditions

learnerGoals.zh: 在复用平台中保留部门资料责任
learnerGoals.en: Retain departmental source ownership on a shared platform

reason.zh: 保留实质判断：学习者必须遇到资料不足时保留暂停与修正空间；不是重填题干给定代码。
reason.en: Retain substantive judgment: the learner must preserve pause and correction options when sources are missing rather than re-enter a supplied code.

learnerGoal.zh: 按新团队条件控制推广节奏
learnerGoal.en: Control rollout pace using new-team conditions

thinking.zh: 遇到资料不足时保留暂停与修正空间
thinking.en: Preserve pause and correction options when sources are missing

understandingEvidence.zh: 实际记录的操作为：选中「暂停该用途并补条件，按证据调整推广节奏」且不选其余候选。这些结果不单独证明学习者已经作出自由解释。
understandingEvidence.en: The captured actions are: Select “Pause that use, repair conditions and adjust rollout pace by evidence” and no other options. These results alone do not establish that the learner has supplied a free explanation.

misconception.zh: 排好计划就必须忽视条件继续
misconception.en: A schedule requires continuing despite unmet conditions

reason.zh: 原题按定义顺序重排，改为对实际成果选择阶段动作而非背阶段词。
reason.en: Replace definition-order recall with choosing stage actions from actual outcomes.

learnerGoal.zh: 用阶段证据决定是否前进或返回
learnerGoal.en: Use stage evidence to progress or return

thinking.zh: 把已知和未知成果连接到当前适合的阶段行动
thinking.en: Connect established and unknown outcomes to an appropriate stage action

understandingEvidence.zh: 实际记录的操作为：提交这些分类位置：「只确定要做AI，尚未说清业务问题」→「明确问题与假设」；「实验价值已验证，但无值守与回退安排」→「补齐生产运行条件」；「当前团队稳定使用，新部门资料和支持条件不同」→「验证更多团队的迁移条件」。这些结果不单独证明学习者已经作出自由解释。
understandingEvidence.en: The captured actions are: Submit these placements: 「Only a desire to use AI exists, with no business problem」→「Clarify problem and assumptions」；「Experimental value is verified, but operations and rollback are undefined」→「Establish production operating conditions」；「The current team operates steadily, while new departments differ in data and support」→「Validate transfer to additional teams」. These results alone do not establish that the learner has supplied a free explanation.

misconception.zh: 阶段名称本身就是验收证据
misconception.en: A stage name is acceptance evidence

reason.zh: 与正式题新部门缺少专家支持分离：任务、资料和支持条件已有匹配证据，考查按条件分批验证而非按参与者身份否决。
reason.en: Unlike the formal new-team expert-support gap, matching tasks, sources and support are evidenced; validate in batches instead of rejecting by participant identity.

learnerGoal.zh: 比较试点与新团队的支持条件
learnerGoal.en: Compare pilot and new-team support conditions

thinking.zh: 在支持和任务条件匹配且获准试用时选择分批验证而非按参与者身份拒绝
thinking.en: Choose batched validation when tasks and support match and a trial is authorized, rather than reject by participant identity

understandingEvidence.zh: 实际记录的操作为：选中「在获准小批范围运行并检查实际迁移表现，保留暂停点；若新证据显示条件不同，重新核对并调整节奏」且不选其余候选。这些结果不单独证明学习者已经作出自由解释。
understandingEvidence.en: The captured actions are: Select “Run the authorized small batch, inspect actual transfer performance and retain pause points；Reassess and adjust pace if new evidence shows changed conditions” and no other options. These results alone do not establish that the learner has supplied a free explanation.

misconception.zh: 原配置可直接替代迁移验证
misconception.en: An original configuration replaces transfer validation

reason.zh: 原分类与COE概览重复，改为处理共享评估与本地过期资料相互推责的故障。
reason.en: Replace repeated CoE role sorting with a failure involving shared evaluation and stale local sources.

learnerGoal.zh: 在复用平台中保留部门资料责任
learnerGoal.en: Retain departmental source ownership on a shared platform

thinking.zh: 给共享方法和本地资料有效性分别指定责任
thinking.en: Assign separate ownership to shared methods and local source validity

understandingEvidence.zh: 实际记录的操作为：选中「业务团队修复本地资料有效性并核验本用例结果；COE帮助复用评估方法与经验，但不替代本部门用途责任」且不选其余候选。这些结果不单独证明学习者已经作出自由解释。
understandingEvidence.en: The captured actions are: Select “The business team repairs local source validity and checks its use-case outcomes；The CoE supports evaluation methods and shared learning without replacing departmental use accountability” and no other options. These results alone do not establish that the learner has supplied a free explanation.

misconception.zh: 共享平台自动接管全部资料责任
misconception.en: A shared platform automatically owns every source

title.zh: 持续价值与运营扩展

learnerGoals.zh: 用成本与风险检验持续价值
learnerGoals.en: Test sustained value against costs and risks

learnerGoals.zh: 把告警接手与持续维护纳入交接
learnerGoals.en: Include alert takeover and ongoing maintenance in handover

learnerGoals.zh: 随规模重验性能与连续性
learnerGoals.en: Revalidate performance and continuity as scale grows

reason.zh: 原题与持续反馈概览同为“使用高还看成本”，改用新期间真实数值检查净结果。
reason.en: Replace repetition of the adoption/cost overview with numerical evidence from a new period.

learnerGoal.zh: 用成本与风险检验持续价值
learnerGoal.en: Test sustained value against costs and risks

thinking.zh: 在使用上升但复核成本激增时重评流程
thinking.en: Reassess when adoption rises but review costs surge

understandingEvidence.zh: 实际记录的操作为：提交判定字段：同期总支出（万元） = 110；收益减支出差额（万元） = -10。这些结果不单独证明学习者已经作出自由解释。
understandingEvidence.en: The captured actions are: Submit the graded fields: Same-period spending (ten-thousand currency units) = 110；Benefits minus spending (ten-thousand currency units) = -10. These results alone do not establish that the learner has supplied a free explanation.

misconception.zh: 成功故事集合可以替代运行数据
misconception.en: Success stories replace operational evidence

reason.zh: 与正式题模型已交付但告警无人接分离：接手和回退均已演练，问题变为验证后版本改变却沿用旧结论。
reason.en: Unlike the formal delivered-file/unowned-alert case, takeover and rollback were drilled; the gap is reusing old conclusions after a version change.

learnerGoal.zh: 把告警接手与持续维护纳入交接
learnerGoal.en: Include alert takeover and ongoing maintenance in handover

thinking.zh: 在接手和回退演练已通过后识别新版本不能沿用旧验证的变更缺口
